tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are planning a surprise birthday party for your classmate, Sarah. You want to hold the party for the whole class at Sarah's favorite restaurant. You need to contact the restaurant manager, Mr. Lee, to make the arrangements. Write an email to Mr. Lee.
bullets: Explain the purpose of the event.
Ask about the offers and accommodations they provide for large groups.
Inquire about any additional services they offer.
tasks.subject: Arrangements for Surprise Birthday Party
